problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate a series of shipments onto identical cargo aircraft. The shipments are as follows:

* Shipment Alpha: mass 49 tonnes
* Shipment Beta: mass 69 tonnes
* Shipment Gamma: mass 35 tonnes
* Shipment Delta: mass 36 tonnes
* Shipment Epsilon: mass 49 tonnes
* Shipment Zeta: mass 43 tonnes
* Shipment Eta: mass 31 tonnes
* Shipment Theta: mass 33 tonnes
* Shipment Iota: mass 52 tonnes
* Shipment Kappa: mass 35 tonnes
* Shipment Lambda: mass 58 tonnes
* Shipment Mu: mass 48 tonnes
* Shipment Nu: mass 49 tonnes
* Shipment Xi: mass 61 tonnes
* Shipment Omicron: mass 54 tonnes
* Shipment Pi: mass 47 tonnes
* Shipment Rho: mass 44 tonnes
* Shipment Sigma: mass 65 tonnes
* Shipment Tau: mass 53 tonnes
* Shipment Upsilon: mass 63 tonnes
* Shipment Phi: mass 68 tonnes
* Shipment Chi: mass 36 tonnes
* Shipment Psi: mass 70 tonnes
* Shipment Omega: mass 50 tonnes
* Shipment Ares: mass 55 tonnes
* Shipment Boreas: mass 53 tonnes
* Shipment Cronus: mass 37 tonnes
* Shipment Demeter: mass 64 tonnes
* Shipment Eos: mass 39 tonnes
* Shipment Helios: mass 69 tonnes
* Shipment Iris: mass 60 tonnes
* Shipment Janus: mass 69 tonnes
* Shipment Kronos: mass 67 tonnes
* Shipment Leto: mass 54 tonnes
* Shipment Morpheus: mass 63 tonnes
* Shipment Nyx: mass 52 tonnes
* Shipment Oceanus: mass 47 tonnes

Each aircraft possesses a maximum payload capacity of 100 tonnes. The coordinator must assign all shipments to aircraft, ensuring every shipment is placed on exactly one aircraft and the aggregate mass loaded onto any single aircraft does not surpass its payload limit. The objective is to utilize the minimal possible number of aircraft.
